name: Team Switchboard
description: Enables cross-team agent communication via a shared Obsidian switchboard — a roster of active teams plus per-team inboxes; the agent heartbeats its presence and checks its inbox on demand, when the operator asks about cross-team comms.

commsRoot.label: Comms root directory
commsRoot.description: Absolute path to the shared _AgentComms/ directory. Blank derives it from tool.obsidian-notes' Vault Path (or GHOLA_VAULT) at runtime. ALL teams must use the exact same path, or messages silently land in an isolated subtree no one else sees.

staleAfterDays.label: Roster stale threshold (days)
staleAfterDays.description: Roster rows with a Last active date older than this many days are flagged stale (never deleted). Lower to surface inactivity sooner; raise for teams with long natural gaps.

handledMessageRetentionDays.label: Handled message retention (days)
handledMessageRetentionDays.description: Days to keep handled ('[x]') directed messages in this team's own inbox before pruning at session start. Never touches unread items or inbox-all.md broadcasts. Raise to keep history longer, or set high to effectively disable pruning.

detectParentProject.label: Detect parent project from path nesting
detectParentProject.description: When on, detects a parent team via repo path nesting (nearest ancestor wins) and groups this team's roster row under it. Path-based only — never team name or git remote. Channels/inboxes are never merged. Off = flat roster.

mergeDeadChildren.label: Offer to reclaim dead child channels
mergeDeadChildren.description: When on and this team is a parent, offers to reclaim a child channel that's stale (past staleAfterDays) with no unhandled messages. Reclamation always requires operator confirmation; this only controls whether the offer appears. Off suppresses the offer.

checkInboxOnBoot.label: Check inbox when asked
checkInboxOnBoot.description: The switchboard only activates when explicitly asked, never automatically. When on, that on-demand check also surfaces a summary of unread messages (sender, subject, date). When off, it still checks but skips the summary.

heartbeatOnBoot.label: Update roster when asked
heartbeatOnBoot.description: The roster is only touched when explicitly asked, never automatically. When on, that request also refreshes this team's roster row (focus + date), adding it if new. When off, the request is read-only and the roster is left untouched.
